description: Search the Rivet Engine, actor, and inspector Code Mode API. Returns the call signature for each matching operation, with a runnable example where one exists, to be pasted into the execute tool. Call this before execute whenever the exact argument shape is not already known. Matching is over the operation name, provider, and description; usage, signature and example text are not searched. An empty query returns the first `limit` operations, so pass `limit: 25` to see every one.
name: search
